contract: Compare AVC and HEVC video descriptors in accepted current PMTs against an independent H.222.0 2.6.64 and 2.6.95 oracle.

Kind 3 begins with program number, PMT version, stream PID and descriptor tag. The AVC row then includes profile, six constraint flags in source order, compatibility flags, level, still-picture flag, 24-hour flag and frame-packing SEI absence flag. The HEVC row includes profile space, tier, profile, profile compatibility, progressive, interlaced, non-packed and frame-only constraints, the copied 44-bit field, level, still-picture flag, 24-hour flag, sub-picture HRD absence, HDR/WCG ID, temporal subset presence and any temporal minimum and maximum. Kind 7 marks clean end.
